name: diteng-agent
description: 帝擎 ERP Electron 桌面壳客户端

scripts.dev: node scripts/configure-build.mjs dev && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,green "vite" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && electron ."
scripts.dev:main: node scripts/configure-build.mjs main && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,green "vite" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && electron ."
scripts.build:app: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
